name: std-learn-sample-accumulator
description: Generic sample-accumulator engine — a Draw button adds a batch of pseudo-random samples from a config-selected source (uniform 0..1, or a coin flip weighted by bias) into a fixed-bin histogram on a math-canvas, with running sample count, running mean, and (for the coin source) observed proportion vs bias. Subject atoms narrow the source kind and labels through config; this atom owns only the draw-and-accumulate mechanics. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

schema.description: Generic sample-accumulator engine — a Draw button adds a batch of pseudo-random samples from a config-selected source (uniform 0..1, or a coin flip weighted by bias) into a fixed-bin histogram on a math-canvas, with running sample count, running mean, and (for the coin source) observed proportion vs bias. Subject atoms narrow the source kind and labels through config; this atom owns only the draw-and-accumulate mechanics. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.
schema.name: std-learn-sample-accumulator

batchSize.description: Number of samples the Draw button adds per click.
batchSize.label: Batch Size
batchSize.synonyms: batch size, draws per click, sample batch

bias.description: Probability the coin source draws 1, used only when sourceKind is coin.
bias.label: Bias
bias.synonyms: probability, bernoulli parameter, coin bias, p

binCount.description: Number of histogram buckets across the 0..1 value range.
binCount.label: Bin Count

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

sourceKind.description: Distribution each draw samples from: uniform (0..1) or coin (Bernoulli 0/1 weighted by bias).
sourceKind.label: Source Kind
sourceKind.synonyms: uniform distribution, coin flip, bernoulli trial, random sampling, source distribution

emits.description: The accumulated sample count and running mean after each draw — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: sample drawn, running mean, law of large numbers, convergence, histogram

emits.description: The accumulator was cleared back to zero samples — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner dragged the batch-size slider — value is the new number of samples each Draw adds.
events.name: Set Batch Size

events.description: The accumulated sample count and running mean after each draw — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Samples Drawn
events.synonyms: sample drawn, running mean, law of large numbers, convergence, histogram

events.description: The accumulator was cleared back to zero samples — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Accumulator Reset
